correctness.rationale: The idempotent normal form is unique by monotonicity, idempotency and regressivity. The mixed-exclusive-color gap criterion is verified in both directions by evaluating floor maps, and independent colored-gap factors give B(z;u,v) and F=B/(1-wB). Conditioning inclusion of successive fixed points gives the claimed two-state bit-sum for every idempotent restricted centralizer. Partial fractions of z/(1-4z+2z²) and its w-derivative give exact totals, asymptotic probability and common-fixed-point expectation. Independently computed rational coefficients include c_5=164 and c_10=76096; C_10 expectation is 19193/4756. These bounded checks supplement the all-n proof in frozen RESULT.md, not replace it.

originality.rationale: Decisive prior mathematical coverage, not merely an identical title or the OEIS sequence: an October 18 theorem states exactly the same mixed-exclusive fixed-point gap criterion and fixed-product fiber formula N_n(H)=product_g(2^{ell_g+1}-1). Its colored-weight insertion yields the present trivariate B and F mechanically. A separate October 25 full theorem gives exactly the same total pair count, asymptotic probability and per-fixed-idempotent centralizer via transfer matrices. The bit-sum is an alternate finite evaluation of that already-covered centralizer, not a new unknown invariant; differentiation of the earlier rank-refined fiber series also yields common-fixed-point statistics.
residual_risks: Trivariate weighting is not printed verbatim in the earlier work, but is a direct algebraic refinement of its complete gap-fiber product, so this does not preserve originality.
The finite check n<=10 does not establish the unbounded claim; the gap proof does.
No full count of arbitrary non-idempotent commuting maps is asserted.
